meta.title: Fix cache not being used when scopes are empty in acquireTokenSilent
meta.body_summary: Fix empty-scopes cache lookup in acquireTokenSilent by defaulting to OIDC scopes instead of throwing an error, reducing unnecessary network requests when cached tokens exist.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed empty-scopes cache skip; maintainer focused on changelog, lint, and package-lock issues; PR closed without merge after back-and-forth process adjustments.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 64804 changed lines, this is a massive change by absolute volume, but the vast majority (64379 lines) is package-lock.json churn; the actual source change is around 18 lines in ScopeSet.ts plus tests and changefiles. This is a small-scope performance fix that was closed without merge, likely due to process friction around formatting and lock file management rather than the performance claim itself.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer tnorling requested changefiles, lint fixes, and package-lock reversion over several comments; the PR was closed after the final Copilot commit addressing all requests, with no approval or further review.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminates unnecessary network requests when cached tokens exist for empty-scope acquireTokenSilent calls.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR after housekeeping iterations but never approved; no explicit rejection of the performance fix itself.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The core code change is simple but Copilot struggled with repository conventions (changelog files, lint/formatting pre-commits, and avoiding package-lock churn), leading to extended back-and-forth and eventual closure without merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer reviewed the change superficially, requesting changelog and fixing lint errors but not engaging with the cache logic directly.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body describes problem but offers no benchmark or timing comparison; the fix prevents an error but there is no measurable performance improvement shown.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no performance regression, but the change never made it to the codebase.

core_change_summary.description: In lib/msal-common/src/request/ScopeSet.ts, modified createSearchScopes to default to OIDC default scopes (openid, profile) when input is empty, instead of throwing an error. Added tests in ScopeSet.spec.ts covering empty arrays, null/undefined inputs.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Massive package-lock.json churn from dev merge and subsequent revert/regeneration; unrelated dependency updates. Changelog file added; .gitignore updated to exclude package-lock.
